seoTitle: Which Gilmore Girls Character Are You? Stars Hollow Test (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Gilmore Girls test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Lorelai, Rory, Luke, Emily, Richard, Paris, Sookie or Lane — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the fast-talking, coffee-fuelled free spirit, the bookworm with big plans, or the grumpy diner owner who secretly cares about everyone? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle family, friends and everyday life, and find out which Gilmore Girls character you are.

characters.name: Lorelai Gilmore
characters.title: The Witty Free Spirit
characters.summary: Fast-talking, funny and fuelled by coffee. You built your own life your own way — and you'll never let anyone tell you how to live it.
description: Like Lorelai, you talk fast, joke faster and run on coffee. Pop-culture references are basically your first language.
You're fiercely independent. Lorelai walked away from her wealthy parents' world as a teenager and built a whole life from scratch — eventually co-owning the Dragonfly Inn.
You're a loyal friend and an even more devoted parent, but you'd rather make a joke than have a serious conversation about your feelings.
characters.flaw: You dodge serious conversations and hold a grudge with your parents.
characters.signature: A giant cup of coffee, a takeout menu and a joke nobody else would get.
characters.clashReason: they'd never stop talking, or take anything seriously

characters.name: Rory Gilmore
characters.title: The Bookworm With Big Dreams
characters.summary: Smart, curious and always carrying a book. You've got big plans — and a lot of people rooting for you.
description: Like Rory, you love reading more than almost anything. There's always a book in your bag.
You're ambitious. Rory went from Chilton to Yale and set her sights on becoming a journalist.
You're thoughtful and kind, but you're still working out who you are — and not every decision along the way is your best.
characters.flaw: You struggle with failure and can be more self-centred than you realise.
characters.signature: A stack of library books, a pro/con list and a Yale sweatshirt.
characters.clashReason: they'd hide in a book rather than face things

characters.name: Luke Danes
characters.title: The Grumpy Softie
characters.summary: Gruff, practical and hates fuss. But you'd do anything for the people you care about — you just won't talk about it.
description: Like Luke, you're a grump. No cell phones in your diner, no nonsense and absolutely no small talk.
But underneath, you're the most dependable person in town. Luke fixes things, feeds everyone and shows up every single time.
You love quietly and deeply. Luke waited years for Lorelai — and never once made a big speech about it.
characters.flaw: You bottle things up until they explode.
characters.signature: A backwards cap, a flannel shirt and a firm "No cell phones."
characters.clashReason: they'd grumble about everything you love

characters.name: Emily Gilmore
characters.title: The Formidable Matriarch
characters.summary: Sharp, formal and impossible to intimidate. You have standards — high ones — and you expect everyone to meet them.
description: Like Emily, you know how things should be done. Proper manners, proper dinners, proper everything.
You're sharp-tongued and quick-witted, and you're never, ever the one who backs down in an argument.
Under the formality, you love your family more than you know how to say — which is why Friday night dinners mean so much.
characters.flaw: You're controlling, and your standards are almost impossible to meet.
characters.signature: Pearls, a perfectly set table and a very pointed comment.
characters.clashReason: they'd judge you from the moment you walked in

characters.name: Richard Gilmore
characters.title: The Distinguished Gentleman
characters.summary: Traditional, dignified and quietly proud of your family. You value hard work, good books and a well-made drink.
description: Like Richard, you're old-fashioned in the best way. A successful businessman, he values tradition, education and doing things properly.
You're warmer than you seem. Richard's bond with Rory, built over Friday night dinners and conversations about books and Yale, meant the world to him.
You don't always know how to say what you feel, but you show it in how proud you are of the people you love.
characters.flaw: You can be stubborn and stuck in your ways.
characters.signature: A tailored suit, a glass of scotch and a well-read newspaper.
characters.clashReason: they care far too much about appearances

characters.name: Paris Geller
characters.title: The Intense Overachiever
characters.summary: Brilliant, driven and terrifyingly intense. You want to be the best at everything — and you usually are.
description: Like Paris, you don't do anything halfway. Every project, every class, every argument — you're going to win.
You're brutally honest. Paris says exactly what she thinks, and she doesn't care if it's polite.
Underneath the intensity, you're more loyal than people realise. Paris went from Rory's rival to one of her closest friends.
characters.flaw: You're so intense that you exhaust everyone around you — including yourself.
characters.signature: A colour-coded planner, a raised voice and a plan to take over the world.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn everything into a competition

characters.name: Sookie St. James
characters.title: The Warm, Chaotic Chef
characters.summary: Sweet, creative and a little bit clumsy. You show love through food — and you're the best friend anyone could ask for.
description: Like Sookie, you're a creative genius in the kitchen. She's a brilliant chef who co-owns the Dragonfly Inn with Lorelai.
You're warm, enthusiastic and slightly chaotic. Things catch fire around you more often than they should.
Most of all, you're a devoted best friend who always has your people's backs — and a plate of something delicious ready for them.
characters.flaw: You're scattered, and you panic when things go wrong.
characters.signature: An apron, a new recipe and a small kitchen fire.
characters.clashReason: they'd bring total chaos into your kitchen

characters.name: Lane Kim
characters.title: The Secret Rock Star
characters.summary: Loyal, passionate and living a double life. You love music more than anything — and you'll find a way to play it.
description: Like Lane, you've got a secret passion. Her strict mother didn't allow rock music, so Lane hid her CDs under the floorboards.
You follow your dreams anyway. Lane became the drummer in a rock band and never gave up on music.
You're Rory's best friend since childhood — loyal, funny and always up for an adventure.
characters.flaw: You avoid conflict by hiding who you really are.
characters.signature: Drumsticks, a secret stash of CDs and a very strict mom.
characters.clashReason: they'd rebel against every rule you set

questions.text: You've got a big exam tomorrow. You...

options.text: Colour-coded notes and an all-nighter
Reread everything twice, then worry anyway
Cram at midnight with junk food and a movie on
Study with headphones on, drumming on the desk

questions.text: A neighbour keeps doing something that drives you mad. You...

options.text: Tell them to knock it off. Loudly
Knock on their door and discuss it calmly, like adults
Write them a very polite, very cutting letter
Say nothing, and stress about it for weeks

questions.text: Your idea of a treat after a long week is...

options.text: Dinner at the club with a good scotch
Redecorating a room. Again
A bookshop and a coffee, for hours
Trying out a new recipe on your friends

questions.text: Someone you love makes a choice you strongly disagree with. You...

options.text: Tell them. Repeatedly
Say nothing, then quietly build them something they need
Argue, then stop speaking to them for a while
Hand them a list of reasons they're wrong

questions.text: You're offered a well-paid job that isn't your passion. You...

options.text: Turn it down. You have a plan
Take it. Hard work builds a good life
Sure — as long as you can play gigs every night
No way. You'd rather do what you love for less

questions.text: The first snow of the year starts to fall. You...

options.text: Run outside. It's the most magical night of the year
Shovel everyone's path before morning
Light a fire, pour a drink and open a good book
Take a quiet walk through town while it's still perfect

questions.text: You're hosting guests this weekend. You...

options.text: Make everything formal, perfect and on schedule
Cook enough food for forty people
Keep it simple. Burgers, done
Give everyone a job. Guests included

questions.text: A friend starts dating someone you can't stand. You...

options.text: Tell them exactly why it's a terrible idea
Understand. You've dated people others didn't approve of
Stay out of it. It's their life
Be supportive to their face, vent about it later

questions.text: Your town holds a meeting about something completely trivial. You...

options.text: Take over the meeting and run it properly
Show up purely for the entertainment
Bring a casserole
Sneak out halfway through. Nobody will notice

questions.text: You're invited to a very fancy charity gala. You...

options.text: Talk business all night in your best suit
Say no. You would rather eat glass
Join the committee — and be running it by next year
Go, and quietly make fun of everything with your best friend

questions.text: Your kid gets into their dream school, but you can't afford it. Your wealthy parents — who you barely speak to — offer to pay, if you come to dinner every Friday. You...

options.text: Swallow your pride and say yes
No. You'll find the money yourself, somehow
Say yes — and secretly enjoy the dinners more than you admit
Negotiate the terms first. In writing

questions.text: You run a small business in a small town. A big chain offers to buy you out for serious money. You...

options.text: Never. This place is your life
Take it, and open the place you've always dreamed of
Hold out for more. Never accept the first offer
Keep it — and turn the back room into a place for live music
